title: Black Hole
textLines: You force yourself to move.
The air feels heavier now, thick with the smell of burning metal.
The corridor tilts beneath your feet, though you know it's not actually slanted.
As you steady yourself against the wall, something strange happens
the metal under your palm hums faintly, then cools, as if exhaling.
For a split second, another scent cuts through the scorched air: disinfectant. Sterilizer. A memory you can't quite reach.
Voices echo down the hall — not real ones, but echoes from a recording. You turn.
A cracked terminal glows weakly, its display stuttering between static and a half-frozen feed.
Figures in uniform rush down the corridor, alarms flashing behind them.
One stops, shouting something you can't hear. The image freezes mid-frame, face twisted in panic.
Then it burns out, leaving the hallway dark again.
You catch sight of a broken placard above the screen:
PROJECT AEQUALIS — Phase IV: Cognitive Stabilization via Professional Transfer
The words mean nothing… yet somehow, they make your stomach tighten.
You move on, passing a viewport set into the wall. At first, you think it's shattered;
the stars beyond look smeared and bent, warping around something so black it almost feels like a hole in your vision.
You take a step closer, pulse pounding.
You glance down the corridor. To your left, a ladder leads up toward the Bridge — maybe you can reach the controls, find out what's happening.
To your right, a flickering sign reads ENGINEERING — if there's any chance to stabilize whatever's causing this, it'll be there.
What do you do?
1.	Head for the Bridge — you need answers.
2.	Go to Engineering — maybe you can still save the ship.
